messages:
Sam: Heads up — our monthly ledger export shows a ~-$2.3k delta in Mar AR vs the billing dashboard. Looks isolated to 'Pro Annual' plan. Anyone else seeing this?
Priya: yeah I noticed some negative proration lines in the export this morning. digging in now.
Jordan: checked webhook-processor logs — lots of 409 idempotency conflicts around 03:12 UTC. DLQ has ~72 messages for invoice events.
Priya: that would explain duplicate credit lines. our dedupe key is event_id but the pricing-experiment flow changed payload and may have dropped plan_code.
Sam: we rolled the experiment on 2026-03-15. if plan_code is missing the dedupe composite could be different and produce duplicates.
Jordan: i'll pause webhook retries for a short window to stop more duplicates. Priya, can you run a preview dedupe/backfill?
Priya: on it. preview command: ```./scripts/reconcile_invoices --since 2026-03-15 --dedupe-key external_event_id --mode=preview``` will show affected invoices. add `--apply` to fix.
Ava: :thumbsup: I'll take the ops window. Pausing retries now: `kubectl annotate deployment webhook-processor maintenance=true --namespace=billing`
billing-bot: Alert: webhook-processor retry policy paused by Ava at 2026-03-20T14:04:10Z
Sam: Finance — please hold on running any refunds or mass adjustments until we finish reconciliation. We'll publish impacted customer list.
Priya: preview returned 48 invoices with duplicate credit lines; totals match the ~$2.3k gap. prepping snapshot: `pg_dump -t invoices -f invoices_snapshot.sql` then will run apply.
Jordan: also we need to update the processor dedupe logic to include plan_code fallback. i'll open a tiny PR.
Priya: PR: github.com/redwood/invoice-processor/pull/438 — adds plan_code fallback and logs dropped events.
Sam: once reconciled, finance: can we set threshold for customer outreach for corrections > $100? we'll want a small note.
Ava: will coordinate with customer-success on notification templates.
billing-bot: Reconciliation job scheduled: billing-reconciler run-preview (initiated by Priya) — ETA ~4m
Priya: running apply now with `--apply`. posting results when done.
Priya: Apply complete. 48 invoices deduped, corrected net change +$2,307.40. Reconciler report: https://internal.redwood/billing/reports/1729456789
Sam: :relieved: great work. Finance, confirm ledger aligns and then close loop on outreach.
Sam: follow-up: add alert for daily proration delta > $500 and assign to Jordan.
Jordan: will add Grafana alert + dashboard panel, ETA EOD.
Ava: ops notes: rollback and runbook updates saved in billing/runbook.md. ping me if anything unexpected shows up.
Priya: also added a unit test to cover missing plan_code in webhook payloads. should prevent regressions.
Sam: thanks all — leaving this thread open until finance confirms ledger match and CS templates queued.
